# Toptal

> Toptal is a global talent marketplace for hiring elite freelance developers, designers, and consultants from the top 3% of professionals worldwide.

Toptal connects businesses with pre-vetted, specialized talent across multiple programming languages, frameworks, and domains. The platform features comprehensive developer directories organized by technology specialization, experience level, and project requirements, enabling companies to find and hire expert freelancers for custom software development, web applications, mobile apps, and emerging technologies.

## Key Topics

- Freelance Hiring

## Core Marketplace

- [Toptal - Hire Talent from the Top 3%](https://www.toptal.com): Toptal homepage showcasing talent marketplace for hiring top developers, designers, and consultants.

## Developer Specializations

- [Full-Stack Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/full-stack): Full-stack developer hiring directory featuring JavaScript, Node.js, and React specialists.
- [Front-End Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/front-end): Front-end developer marketplace with React and JavaScript specialists for UI development.
- [Web Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/web): Web developer marketplace for full-stack and front-end development projects.
- [Software Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/software): Software developer hiring directory featuring C++, C#, and full-stack specialists.

## Programming Languages & Frameworks

- [JavaScript Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/javascript): JavaScript developer marketplace featuring React and TypeScript experts.
- [Java Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/java): Java developer marketplace for enterprise and microservices development.
- [Node.js Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/nodejs): Node.js backend and full-stack developer marketplace.
- [PHP Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/php): PHP developer marketplace featuring Laravel and WordPress specialists.
- [Django Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/django): Django and Python web development specialists marketplace.
- [AngularJS Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/angular-js): AngularJS and Angular developer marketplace for single-page application development.

## Mobile & App Development

- [Mobile App Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/app): Mobile app developer directory for iOS, Android, and cross-platform development.
- [iOS Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/ios): iOS developer hiring directory featuring Swift and Objective-C specialists.
- [Android Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/android): Android developer hiring directory for mobile app development specialists.

## Specialized Technologies

- [AI Engineers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/artificial-intelligence): AI engineer marketplace featuring machine learning and AI specialist talent.
- [Game Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/game): Game developer marketplace featuring Unity, Unreal Engine, and C++ specialists.
- [Kubernetes Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/kubernetes): Kubernetes and DevOps engineer marketplace for cloud-native infrastructure.
- [Big Data & Hadoop Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/hadoop): Big data and Hadoop developer marketplace for data engineering projects.

## CMS & eCommerce Platforms

- [Drupal Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/drupal): Drupal and PHP CMS development specialists for enterprise solutions.
- [Magento Developers](https://www.toptal.com/developers/magento): Magento and ecommerce development specialists marketplace.
